title: THE SOCIOLOGY OF GLOBALIZATION
description: Examines the sociological effect of globalization on Western and non-Western societies. The course focuses on changes in the global economy and how this has influenced the social structure, patterns of change, and mutual influences among societies.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 12pm-1:50pm in BEXL 416 - Bexell Hall 416 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
